paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20 for different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE20" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.8 to 1.3, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue, solid line), Head Tuning (orange, solid line), FT (green, solid line), LoRA 16 (red, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line). TrajICL starts at around 0.9 and decreases gradually to approximately 0.85. Head Tuning begins at 1.3 and declines to about 1.05. FT starts at 1.1 and decreases to around 0.8. LoRA 16 begins at 1.2 and decreases to approximately 0.925. LoRA 64 starts at 1.2 and declines to around 0.925. All lines exhibit a downward trend as the ratio increases, with some lines showing a more gradual decline than others.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minFDE20 for various models, including TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis represents the ratio, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 with increments of 0.2, while the y-axis represents minFDE20, spanning from 0.8 to 1.3 with increments of 0.1. TrajICL is depicted by a blue solid line with circle markers, starting at approximately 0.9 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to around 0.85 at a ratio of 1.0. Head Tuning is represented by an orange solid line with square markers, beginning at about 1.3 at a ratio of 0.1 and declining to roughly 1.05 at a ratio of 1.0, becoming lighter beyond a ratio of 0.7. FT is shown as a green solid line with diamond markers, commencing at approximately 1.1 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to around 0.8 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 16 is illustrated by a red solid line with triangle markers, starting at about 1.2 at a ratio of 0.1 and dropping to roughly 0.93 at a ratio of 1.0. LoRA 64 is depicted by a purple solid line with cross markers, beginning at approximately 1.2 at a ratio of 0.1 and decreasing to around 0.93 at a ratio of 1.0, becoming lighter beyond a ratio of 0.7. Overall, all models exhibit a downward trend in minFDE20 as the ratio increases.
